headline: Colonial Advances Reshape Marban Hollow as Northern Fronts Trade Fierce Blows
war_summary: Over the past three hours, the tactical picture shifted dramatically in Marban Hollow, where a sudden surge of fighting at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall saw Warden holdings dwindle to a single base, leaving Colonials in possession of six and one reduced to neutral ground. Across Kuura Strand, the Colonials' brief monopoly was severed as Warden forces reclaimed a foothold, splitting the sector five to one. The northern highlands remain engulfed in bitter combat: Weathered Expanse logged nine base shifts in two hours around Crow's Nest and Wightwalk, allowing Wardens to claw back a third redoubt alongside four Colonial positions and two unheld ruins. Along the Nevish Line, eight rapid turnovers left four Warden bastions, two Colonial redoubts, and two neutral vacancies amidst mounting butcher's bills. Further south, Linn of Mercy witnessed three additional transfers near Lathair and Outwich Ranch, while an isolated clash at Argosa in Godcrofts knocked that outpost into no-man's-land. Although Callahan's Passage continues to bleed heavily with nearly nine hundred casualties over two hours, its fortified perimeter held intact, and the previously turbulent Stlican Shelf settled into temporary quiet.
